spans.s:
उभ pron. a. (Used only in the
dual) Both उभौ तौ न विजानीतः

उभय pron. a. (यी f.) (Though
dual in sense, it is used in the
singular and plural only; according to
some grammarians in the dual also)
Both (of persons or things);
उभयमप्यपरितोषं समर्थये Ś. 7;
उभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः

; 9. 34.
--Comp.
--अर्थं ind. for a
double object (for earthly
prosperity and heavenly happiness also).
--आत्मक a. belonging to both.
--चर a. living in water and on
land or in the air, amphibious.
--(रः) a class of birds who
live both on land and in the air.
--द्युः ind. {1} on both days. {2} the
day past and to come.
--भागहर a.
{1} applicable to two objects. {2}
taking two shares.
--(रं) a
medicine that acts in two ways (both
as an emetic and a purgative).
--विद्या two fold sciences; i. e.
religious knowledge and knowledge
about worldly affairs.
--विध a.
of both kinds.
--वेतन a. receiving
wages from both (parties), serving
two masters, treacherous, perfidious;
उभयवेतनो भूत्वा

; Śi. 2. 113.
--व्यंजन a. having the marks of both
sexes.
--संभवः a dilemma.

उभया ind. Ved. In both ways.
--Comp.
--दत् a. having teeth on
both sides.
--विन् a. being on both
sides, partaking of both.
--हस्ति
ind. as much as may be grasped
with both hands.
--हस्त्य a. filling
both hands.

उभयतः ind.
1 From both sides,
on both sides, to both sides
[]
(with acc.); उभयतः कृष्णं गोपाः Sk.
तज्जः पुनात्युभयतः पुरुषानेकविंशतिं

.
--2 In both
cases.
--3 In both ways;

.
--Comp.
--क्षुत् a. two-edged (Ved.).
--दत्, --दंत a. having a double row
of teeth; पशून् मृगान् मनुष्यांश्च
व्यालांश्चोभयतोदतः

-7
--ह्रस्व a. (an accented
vowel) produced by two short vowels.

उभयत्र ind.
1 In both places.
--2
On both sides; ˚उदात्त having an
Udātta accent on both sides.
--3 In
both cases;

उभये(य)द्युस् ind.
1 On both
days.
--2 On two subsequent days.

उभये(य)द्युस् ind.
1 On both
days.
--2 On two subsequent days.
